name: ModelVariant830_HandleRequest
evidence: matching model_variant/variant830_entry.c: the image entry at base + 4 (the camera swings through three cues while the slot is tinted and flashes white; after the delay a burst of sparks grows at the opponent's position, a flickering glow rises from it, two sets of expanding rings spread around it and debris is thrown up and falls back while the colours fade and the green and blue ambient light dims and recovers); for a non-negative request it selects the config record indexed by the request, seeds the sparks, rings and debris and packs four texture images, otherwise it runs one frame and returns 0 before the delay, 1 once on the first frame after it, 2 once the light has recovered and the last spark has burnt out and 0 otherwise; Model_UpdateSlotControl calls the variant at base + 4 with the request modulo 1000 and then -1 (notes/model-structures.md)
notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the same address in every bound image; the French header-847 and 944 images build it from the same source. HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.
